en.battle.subtitle: The Ember Trial
en.battle.drag: Drag a card upward to play
en.battle.chooseTarget: Drop on a glowing target, or release on open ground for smart targeting
en.battle.autoTurn: The enemy acts after your second card
en.battle.heal: Recover {amount} Health before the next encounter.
en.mechanic.armor: Stone Skin · Gains 3 Shield each turn
en.mechanic.thorns: Runic Thorns · Attacks retaliate for 1; destroy the supporting Shard
en.mechanic.critical: Skyfire Precision · Every 3rd attack is a double-damage Critical; the Raven also attacks
en.mechanic.forge: Forge Overload · Gains 2 Shield, grows each round, gains +2 damage below half Health, and commands two Sparks
en.enemy.name: Hollowstone Sentinel
en.battle.tap: Tap a card to play it.
en.card.exhaust: Exhaust: removed for this battle after use.
en.battle.outcomeDetail: Begin another trial with a newly shuffled deck.
en.battle.welcome: Your contract begins. Meet the sentinel with fire and resolve.
en.battle.played: Card resolved. Choose your next move.
en.battle.nextTurn: The sentinel acted. Your energy is restored.
en.battle.rules: Keep unplayed cards and draw back up to 5 each turn. Played cards stay in Discard for this battle unless a card explicitly recycles them. Play 2 cards, then all surviving enemies attack.
en.pile.orderNote: Cards are grouped by type. Draw order is hidden.
en.pile.drawDetail: Your fixed 25-card battle deck. At turn start, draw from here until your hand contains five cards. It does not refill automatically this battle.
en.pile.discardDetail: Played cards stay here for the rest of this battle unless a card explicitly recycles them. Unplayed cards remain in your hand.
en.pile.exhaustDetail: One-use cards stay removed from this battle, so timing them matters.
en.restart.title: Start a new battle?
en.restart.message: Your current battle will be replaced.
en.error.title: Unable to act
en.error.actions: You have already played two cards this turn.
en.error.card: That card is no longer in your hand.
en.error.targetMissing: That target is no longer available.
en.error.targetSelf: A purely harmful card cannot target your spirit.
en.error.targetEnemy: A purely beneficial card cannot target an enemy.
en.error.content: Game content could not be loaded. Please retry.
en.status.burn.detail: At turn end, take {amount} damage, then lose {decay} Burn. Shield absorbs this damage.
en.status.focus.detail: Your next attack deals {bonus} extra damage on its first hit, then consumes Focus.
en.card.special.recycleDiscard: Shuffle up to 2 cards from Discard into Draw.
en.card.special.recoverExhaust: Return the newest Exhausted card to your hand.
en.card.special.stun: Stun: target skips its next attack.
en.mechanic.chapter1: Training · Learn targeting and enemy intents.
en.mechanic.chapter2: Element Cycle · Stone beats Fire, Fire beats Spirit, Spirit beats Stone.
en.mechanic.chapter3: Critical Rhythm · Every third enemy attack deals double damage.
en.mechanic.chapter4: Stone Armor · Enemies gain 4 Shield every turn.
en.mechanic.chapter5: Runic Thorns · Direct attacks retaliate for 1 damage.
en.mechanic.chapter6: Spirit Swarm · Additional enemies join the formation.
en.mechanic.chapter7: Renewal · Enemies restore 3 Health before attacking.
en.mechanic.chapter8: Mist Step · Every third incoming hit is dodged.
en.mechanic.chapter9: Rising Fury · Enemy attack grows each round.
en.mechanic.chapter10: Worldforge · Armor, criticals, elements and overload combine.

zh-Hans.battle.subtitle: 烬火试炼
zh-Hans.battle.drag: 向上拖出卡牌即可使用
zh-Hans.battle.chooseTarget: 拖到发光目标上；在空白处松手会智能选择目标
zh-Hans.battle.enemyAttack: 敌人攻击，造成 {damage} 点伤害
zh-Hans.battle.actions: 本回合还可出牌 {amount} 次
zh-Hans.battle.actionsRemaining: 本回合还可出牌 {amount} 次
zh-Hans.battle.autoTurn: 打出第二张牌后，敌人自动行动
zh-Hans.battle.heal: 进入下一场战斗前恢复 {amount} 点生命。
zh-Hans.mechanic.basic: 静默岩心 · 无特殊能力
zh-Hans.mechanic.armor: 岩石皮肤 · 每回合获得 3 点护盾
zh-Hans.mechanic.thorns: 符文反刺 · 攻击会反伤 1 点；优先摧毁辅助晶核
zh-Hans.mechanic.critical: 天火精准 · 每第 3 次攻击造成双倍暴击；烬羽鸦也会攻击
zh-Hans.mechanic.forge: 锻炉过载 · 每回合获得 2 点护盾，攻击逐轮增强，半血后伤害 +2，并指挥两只火灵
zh-Hans.enemy.name: 空岩守卫
zh-Hans.enemy.intent: 下次行动：攻击，造成 {damage} 点伤害
zh-Hans.enemy.intentCritical: 下次行动：暴击，造成 {damage} 点伤害
zh-Hans.enemy.intentEmpowered: 下次行动：过载攻击，造成 {damage} 点伤害
zh-Hans.card.exhaust: 消耗：使用后移出本场战斗。
zh-Hans.battle.outcomeDetail: 以重新洗好的牌组开始下一次试炼。
zh-Hans.battle.welcome: 契约已成。以火焰与决心迎战守卫。
zh-Hans.battle.played: 卡牌已结算。请选择下一步行动。
zh-Hans.battle.nextTurn: 守卫已行动。你的能量已恢复。
zh-Hans.battle.rules: 未使用的牌会保留，每回合从固定 25 张牌组补至 5 张。用过的牌本关留在弃牌堆，只有明确写有回收效果的卡可以再次取回。打出 2 张牌后，所有存活敌人攻击。
zh-Hans.pile.orderNote: 卡牌按类型排列，不显示抽牌顺序。
zh-Hans.pile.drawDetail: 本关固定 25 张牌组。回合开始时从这里补牌至五张；本关不会自动把弃牌洗回。
zh-Hans.pile.discardDetail: 本关已打出的牌留在这里，不会再次抽到；只有明确写有回收效果的卡可以取回。未使用的手牌继续保留。
zh-Hans.pile.exhaustDetail: 一次性卡牌会在本场战斗中移出牌组，使用时机很重要。
zh-Hans.restart.title: 开始新的战斗？
zh-Hans.error.title: 无法执行操作
zh-Hans.error.actions: 本回合已经使用了两张牌。
zh-Hans.error.targetSelf: 纯负面卡牌不能对自己的灵兽使用。
zh-Hans.error.targetEnemy: 纯增益卡牌不能对敌人使用。
zh-Hans.error.content: 无法加载游戏内容，请重试。
zh-Hans.status.burn.detail: 回合结束时受到 {amount} 点伤害，随后减少 {decay} 层灼烧。护盾可吸收此伤害。
zh-Hans.status.focus.detail: 下一张攻击牌的首次伤害增加 {bonus} 点，随后消耗凝神。
zh-Hans.card.special.recycleDiscard: 将弃牌堆中至多 2 张牌洗入抽牌堆。
zh-Hans.card.special.recoverExhaust: 将消耗堆最上方的牌返回手牌。
zh-Hans.card.special.cleave: 群攻：命中所有存活敌人。
zh-Hans.card.special.stun: 封印：目标跳过下一次攻击。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter1: 新手试炼 · 学习指定目标与敌人意图。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter2: 属性轮转 · 岩克火、火克灵、灵克岩。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter3: 暴击节奏 · 敌人每第 3 次攻击造成双倍伤害。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter4: 岩甲 · 敌人每回合获得 4 点护盾。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter5: 符文反刺 · 直接攻击会受到 1 点反伤。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter6: 灵群 · 更多敌人同时加入战场。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter7: 复苏 · 敌人在攻击前恢复 3 点生命。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter8: 雾步 · 每第 3 次受到的攻击会被闪避。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter9: 怒火增长 · 敌人的攻击逐回合提高。
zh-Hans.mechanic.chapter10: 万象熔炉 · 护甲、暴击、属性和过载同时出现。
